description: Reviewed raw progress variables extracted from pinned PRET sources. Values are not automatic quest completion.

entries.description: Raw roaming species choice: 0 = Latias, 1 = Latios. Zero is also the initial value; this is not proof of a choice before the postgame TV scene finishes.
Raw player-house scene state. The TV-choice script sets this to 4 after InitRoamer; combine with the roaming flag before interpreting the species choice.
Raw player-house scene state. The TV-choice script sets this to 4 after InitRoamer; this value alone is not a capture record.
Raw Devon revival phase: 1 = submitted and regenerating; 2 = ready to receive. State 0 is initial or reset after collection, so combine with received-fossil flag and fossil species value.
Raw submitted fossil: 1 = Root Fossil/Lileep, 2 = Claw Fossil/Anorith. It can remain after collection and must be combined with the revival phase.

Raw generator state: 2 means the stop switch was activated. Combine with FLAG_GOT_BASEMENT_KEY_FROM_WATTSON and FLAG_GOT_TM_THUNDERBOLT_FROM_WATTSON to distinguish acceptance, generator shutdown, and reward collection.
Raw puzzle progression: entrance script routes values 0 through 7 to puzzles 1 through 8; 8 selects the finished-puzzles branch. Initial zero does not prove the quest has started.
Raw current-puzzle hide-and-seek flag stored as a variable. Reset for new puzzles; not permanent whole-quest completion.
Raw entrance dialogue/scene state. Interpret using the entrance script, not as a count of completed puzzles.

Raw pending-reward state: the end-room script sets 1 when the bag or decoration storage is full and the prize cannot be delivered. Reward branches clear it to 0; zero is also initial, so combine with level and entrance state.
Raw puzzle 1 script state. It is a per-puzzle phase, not a boolean or a count; consult that puzzle script and the entrance/end scripts.
